name: open-claw-skills
description: open-claw-skills — 4,957 curated OpenClaw skills from GitHub. Auto-registers a remote provider on install.

install_steps: No binary dependencies — pure remote skill library
Skills are auto-indexed from GitHub on first sync
install_guidance.note: Registers a remote_repo provider pointing to github.com/javimosch/open-claw-skills. Run 'supercli skills sync' after install.
